name: claude-micro-bridge
description: macOS tmux bridge daemon connecting Claude Code sessions to the Work Louder Codex Micro.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && zsh -n src/tmux-start-bridge.sh && zsh -n src/tmux-stop-bridge.sh && zsh -n src/tmux-reset-bridge.sh
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --import tsx --test test/bridge.test.ts test/lifecycle.test.ts test/plugin.test.ts
